  • Method Details

    • initializeDatabase

      public static void initializeDatabase()
      Creates every database table required by the application if they do not already exist. Should be called once before any database reads or writes.

    • getOrCreateUser

      public static User getOrCreateUser(String username, String password, int defaultBalance)
      Returns an existing user matching the given username, or inserts a new one with the specified default balance if none is found.
      Parameters:
      username - the username to look up
      password - the password to assign if a new user is created
      defaultBalance - the starting chip balance for a newly created user
      Returns:
      the existing or newly created User

    • createGameSession

      public static int createGameSession(User user, Game game, Player player)
      Inserts a new game session record for the given user and returns its generated session id. Returns -1 if user is null.
      Parameters:
      user - the logged-in User starting the game
      game - the Game instance containing session configuration
      player - the human Player whose starting balance is recorded
      Returns:
      the generated session id, or -1 if the insert was skipped

    • recordRound

      public static void recordRound(int gameSessionId, Round round)
      Saves a completed round's log to the database, linked to the given session. Does nothing if gameSessionId is non-positive.
      Parameters:
      gameSessionId - the session id that the round belongs to
      round - the completed Round whose data should be persisted

    • saveUserProgress

      public static void saveUserProgress(User user, Player player)
      Updates the user's balance in the database mid-game so partial progress is not lost if the application exits unexpectedly.
      Parameters:
      user - the User whose balance should be updated; ignored if null
      player - the Player whose current balance will be saved to the user record

    • finalizeGameSession

      public static void finalizeGameSession(int gameSessionId, User user, Game game, Player player)
      Finalises the game session in the database: updates the user's balance, increments wins if the user's ending balance exceeds their starting balance, and marks the session as finished. Does nothing if user is null.
      Parameters:
      gameSessionId - the session id to finalise; a non-positive id skips the session update
      user - the User whose profile stats are updated
      game - the Game holding the starting balance reference
      player - the Player whose final balance is written back to the user record

    • getAllUsers

      public static List<User> getAllUsers()
      Returns every user profile stored in the database.
      Returns:
      a list of all User objects, or an empty list if the table is empty
